explanation: The statement is a definitional unfolding of a library-specific definition, `AlgebraicGeometry.rootsOfUnityGroupSchemeInclusion`, which is defined via Mathlib's `hopfSpec` applied to `CommHopfAlgCat.ofHom (AddMonoidAlgebra.mapDomainBialgHom K (Int.castAddHom (ZMod n)))`. Neither `rootsOfUnityGroupScheme`, `multiplicativeGroupScheme` nor any group scheme of roots of unity exists in Mathlib (the only `rootsOfUnity` declarations in Mathlib concern the subgroup of units of a commutative monoid, in Mathlib/RingTheory/RootsOfUnity/*), and Mathlib has no general lemma computing `((hopfSpec R).map f).hom.hom.left` for a Hopf-algebra morphism f (searching Mathlib/AlgebraicGeometry/Group/Affine.lean shows only `algSpec`/`Spec`-level lemmas, e.g. `algSpec_map_left`, and no `hopfSpec.map` computation). Hence there is no Mathlib declaration stating this equality.
